# Cadence — Template Tasks

## Source

- **ColorLib template:** Musica
- **Preview:** https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/musica/
- **Screenshot:** https://colorlib.com/wp/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/musica-free-template.jpg

## Design Tokens

- Font: Raleway (Google Fonts) + Allura (decorative)
- Primary gradient: #cc1573 (hot pink) → #5722a9 (deep purple)
- Dark background: #150430 (deep navy/purple)
- Overlay: rgba(21, 4, 48, 0.89)
- Text: #262626 (headings), #6a6a6a (body), #ffffff (on dark)
- Accent: #c5afd9 (lavender)

## Sections

1. Navbar — sticky, dark bg, brand text, nav links, social icons, mobile toggle
2. Hero — full-viewport bg image, dark overlay, gradient bar, watermark, heading, subtitle
3. Artist Bio — parallax bg, dark overlay, heading, 2-col (image + bio text)
4. Upcoming Shows — white bg, list of events with date/image/name/venue/time/CTA
5. Music Player — dark bg, 4-col grid of track cards with play overlay
6. Featured Album — 2-col (album cover + song playlist), now-playing bar
7. Music/Artists Search — 2 side-by-side panels with bg images
8. Footer — dark bg, brand, link columns, subscribe form, Component Dock link
